text:
maya: Heads-up — cutoff in ~2h. Can folks do a quick branch sweep (release/v2.4) and a full green run? If any flaky tests pop, call them out here and tag owners.
chris: on it, running `./scripts/ci/green-sweep.sh release/v2.4` now. Will post failures.
lina: rebase done for my PR, but seeing one flaky in `tests/e2e/streaming_spec.py` locally — pinging @sam to sanity-check.
sam: I saw that yesterday, likely timing-sensitive. I'll run a repeated job 10x and attach logs. ETA 12m.
ci-bot: CI queued: green-sweep job 47213 for branch release/v2.4 (triggered by chris).
maya: thanks. if green-sweep fails for infra reasons (queue/missing agents) we can toggle to dedicated runners — prefer to avoid last-minute dedicated scale unless required.
rajesh: FYI I found a flaky in `auth/test_token_refresh` causing nondeterministic failures under heavy load — is that on the same matrix?
chris: not the same, but will include that test in the sweep matrix, adding `--focus auth/test_token_refresh` to retries.
sam: repeated run results: `streaming_spec.py` failed 3/10 with socket timeout. Stack: 
```
RequestError: read timeout after 8s
  at tests/e2e/streaming_spec.py:58
```
lina: thanks — I can add a small backoff in the test harness to reduce flakiness, will open tiny PR (aim < 10LOC).
maya: perfect. schedule: if we have green in 90m we still ship. If not, decide on a 2h rollover. Please ping me directly if anything blocks.
deploy-bot: Reminder: changelog entry required for any API surface changes before cutoff — see https://redwood.dev/changelog-guidelines
chris: quick note — one job is timing out on macOS-latest runners (setup-homebrew hang). Trying rerun on linux-only matrix to unblock.
ci-bot: Workflow rerun started: green-sweep job 47214 (linux-only)
rajesh: if macos is flaky we can skip mac for this release, but need approval from maya. @maya?
maya: skip mac for this release if it blocks the sweep. Make a note in the release notes and we'll add a follow-up ticket to stabilize mac runners. :+1:
chris: green-sweep linux-only passed 100% — attaching job id 47214/logs (link).
ci-bot: job 47214 marked success.
sam: streaming test PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/4321 — small wait/backoff. Requesting quick review @lina @chris.
lina: reviewing now. small nit then LGTM.
maya: awesome. once PR merges, rerun full sweep and then we can cut the tag. Who's on tag+publish?
chris: I'll cut v2.4.0-rc1 and run smoke.
maya: thanks team — keep pings here for anything that looks like a blocker. :rocket:
